author: reform99
quote: Crimson Desert's open world is something incredible. Everything is so interactive! Right from the start I was instantly immersed into it. I love how the more you play, the better it gets. Progression is amazing, you never feel like you've seen everything the game has to offer and keep learning new things. The gameplay in terms of combat is just pure cinema, when you get more skill points it becomes a mechanical masterpiece. Unlike some people I find the story quite decent, even interesting I would say. It's definitely not the main sell point of the game and nothing insane by story game standards, but it is not bad at all. The environment is often breath taking (especially if you combine a HUD removal mod with it). There is just so much to do, the possibilities are truly endless! Huge recommend from me to anyone who is into open world adventure games, 10/10!!!
